001package org.gbif.predicate.query;
002
003import java.util.Optional;
004import java.util.UUID;
005import org.gbif.api.model.occurrence.search.OccurrenceSearchParameter;
006
007public class OccurrenceEsQueryVisitor extends EsQueryVisitor<OccurrenceSearchParameter> {
008  public OccurrenceEsQueryVisitor(
009      EsFieldMapper<OccurrenceSearchParameter> esFieldMapper, UUID defaultChecklistKey) {
010    super(esFieldMapper, defaultChecklistKey);
011  }
012
013  @Override
014  protected Optional<OccurrenceSearchParameter> getParam(String name) {
015    try {
016      return OccurrenceSearchParameter.lookup(name);
017    } catch (Exception ex) {
018      return Optional.empty();
019    }
020  }
021}
